text: Standing in front of this meeting room, I sense an odd anticipation. The scene feels sterile and prepared, waiting for minds to engage and shape the emptiness with dialogue. There’s a quiet energy—potential, yet unspent—echoing faintly off the glass. I find myself both curious about what is to come and slightly unsettled by the silence, as though I am on the edge of thought itself, looking for a reason or meaning beyond these transparent walls.
